newsitem.title: USA: NBA BASKETBALL - LAKERS' O'NEAL TO MISS ANOTHER WEEK, INCLUDING ALL-STAR GAME.
newsitem.headline: NBA BASKETBALL - LAKERS' O'NEAL TO MISS ANOTHER WEEK, INCLUDING ALL-STAR GAME.

text.p: Lakers star centre Shaquille O'Neal, who sat out Tuesday's loss to the Los Angeles Clippers with a sprained right knee, will miss at least the next week of action, including Sunday's All-Star Game in Cleveland.
O'Neal had his right knee examined again Wednesday and will continue to receive treatment and therapy for a sprained medial collateral ligament, the team doctor said.

O'Neal suffered the injury in Sunday's 129-99 rout of the Washington Bullets. He scored 24 points on 11-of-17 shooting before he knocked knees with Washington centre Gheorghe Muresan in the last minute of the third quarter.
His presence was sorely missed in Tuesday's loss to the Clippers. Without O'Neal, the Lakers were outrebounded 54-31 by the Clippers.

O'Neal left the Orlando Magic to sign a seven-year, $123 million deal with the Lakers in the off-season. He is averaging 26.2 points and 13.0 rebounds per game, leading the Lakers (34-13) to the best record in the Western Conference.
